Undelucram.ro on behalf of:
 Evolve Today
 We are recruiting a DevOps Engineer with hands-on Kubernetes and cloud expertise and a strong automation mindset for our client , an international group with 30 years of presence in Romania , whose polymer-based solutions shape everyday life. You’ll join their growing IT team in Bucharest and help deliver reliable, scalable platforms for their development teams.
In this role, you will be responsible for building, automating, and operating modern cloud and container infrastructures . You’ll work closely with development teams to implement efficient CI/CD processes, while ensuring scalable, reliable, and observable system operations across on-premises and cloud environments (AWS and Azure) and collaborating with security teams on SOC requirements.
 If Kubernetes, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code are your daily tools, apply now — let’s see if it’s a match.
 Main Responsibilities
Build, operate, and continuously improve Kubernetes clusters in on-premises and cloud environments
Implement and maintain GitOps workflows, for example, using Argo CD or Flux
Automate infrastructure and deployments using Infrastructure as Code
Design, implement, and operate CI/CD pipelines
Manage and optimize cloud environments in AWS and Azure
Ensure system reliability, monitoring, and observability, for example using Prometheus and Grafana
Collaborate with security teams to meet SOC requirements and implement best practices
Evaluate and integrate open-source technologies
Troubleshoot issues, optimize performance, and support incident response
 Requirements
At least 4 years of experience in DevOps or Cloud Engineering
Strong knowledge of Kubernetes and container technologies such as Docker
Experience with GitOps principles and related tools
Solid experience with AWS
Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting systems
Understanding of security concepts and SOC processes
Strong Linux and networking skills
Experience with automation tools such as Terraform and Ansible
Programming or scripting skills, for example in Python or Bash
High degree of ownership; solution-oriented way of working
Excellent communication and teamwork skills
Analytical capabilities and a structured approach to problem-solving
Willingness to learn and contribute to continuous improvement
English: business proficient / negotiation level
 Nice to Have
Knowledge of policy as code and security scanning tools
Experience operating open-source platforms
Experience with Azure
Good working knowledge of German
